messages:
maria: Quick thread 55 025 - planning analyst brief ahead of the Dedicated launch. Need embargo timing, who joins, and the quote approval flow. Can the core folks chime in?

jon: I can run logistics + the calendar invite. Tue/Wed mornings PT work for me.

kevin: I'll cover the benchmark narrative and methodology appendix. Will flag the three claims we can defend.

sara: Legal here. Proposed embargo window? Also confirm whether analysts get a fact-check doc or only Q&A on the call.

maria: Thinking embargo lift = 2025-11-12T20:00:00Z. Offer a 36-hour fact-check window for analysts to return factual corrections only. Legal sign-off required on any quote text before publication. @sara

sara: 36h is fine if we receive consolidated corrections in one doc and quotes in plain text. No tracked-change docs please.

lina: For speakers: Product (kevin), Benchmarks (kevin), Ops (jon), Exec quote (maria). Who will craft quote drafts?

maria: I'll draft an exec quote, Kevin will draft product quote. Both must be approved by Legal and the speaker.

jon: Suggested analyst list: InfraNow, CloudEdge Research, Enterprise ML Signals, and two independents. Will share email list in the invite.

kevin: On benchmarks: I'll attach a short methods appendix and a CSV of raw runs (sanitized). Recommend we only give the CSV to analyst contacts under embargo.

sara: Legal: give CSV but mark it "For fact-check only under embargo" and require deletion confirmation. We'll include a minimal NDA clause in the invite where applicable.

maria: Good. Process we should follow: 1) Send fact-check doc + appendix + proposed quotes to analysts 48h before embargo lift; 2) Analysts return factual corrections within 36h; 3) Marketing consolidates; 4) Legal signs off; 5) Execs sign final quote text.

pressbot: calendar: "Analyst briefing 1 Dedicated launch" created for 2025-11-11 09:00 PT. Recording disabled by host. Invite sent.

jon: Ops checklist I'm tracking: lock embargo time (maria/sara), finalize analyst invite list (jon), upload fact-check doc + CSV (kevin), draft quotes (maria/kevin), legal review (sara), collect returns (jon).

maria: Want to discuss exclusives: do we offer a one-hour embargoed exclusive to a top-tier? Pros/cons?

kevin: Exclusive could increase headline impact but complicates other briefings. If we consider it, propose we do a 12-hour exclusive for one top-tier and keep rest embargoed for others.

sara: If exclusive is considered, legal needs to review the terms and ensure the embargo window is clearly defined for that outlet only. Avoid staggered embargo language that conflicts.

lina: My preference is non-exclusive for fairness and simpler ops.

maria: OK let's keep non-exclusive. If a top-tier asks, we'll evaluate on a case-by-case and require the same legal terms.

jon: About quote sign-off: let's collect final one-line quotes in a single doc and route to Legal, then to the exec for a single sign-off email. No inline edits from analysts allowed; only factual corrections.

kevin: I'll annotate the benchmark appendix with the exact commands and configs used. That should handle deep-dive questions.

sara: I'll prepare a short legal checklist for quote wording: declarative, no comparative language, no customer-identifying metrics without customer consent.

maria: I'll assemble a 4-slide teaser deck for the call and share it with analysts 24h before the briefing. No raw cost-per-token tables in the deck.

pressbot: reminder: Fact-check doc distribution scheduled for 2025-11-09 10:00 PT.

jon: After the briefing plan: collect feedback, apply factual corrections, run final legal check, publish press release at embargo lift. I'm happy to own consolidation.

maria: Thanks, Jon. Final ask: everyone avoid public posting of any materials until embargo lift. Use this thread for all returns and questions. :lock: :eyes:

kevin: Acknowledged.

sara: Acknowledged.
